title: PlacementNdjsonRecord
description: One placement line streamed by `--json -j N` with `N > 1`, beside the verb's own per-repo lines: a flat object whose `$schema` names `placement-record.json`, which is how a consumer tells the two apart.

absolute_path.description: The checkout whose files were placed.

files.description: How many files were cloned, linked or written.

FilePlacement.description: How a member's tracked files reached a workspace.

hardlinked.description: Linked to another workspace's read-only copy.

reflinked.description: Cloned from another workspace's copy, sharing its storage until either is written.

written.description: Written by the version control system.
